Subject: Approval to Proceed with Invoice-Handling Pilot

Hi Morgan,

I’m proposing we move forward with the approved six-week pilot to assess invoice handling. The pilot would be limited to assessment activities; production rollout is excluded.

The fixed fee is $30,000. The client’s target is a 20% reduction in handling time, although no baseline or measured savings currently exists, so the pilot would help establish the evidence needed to evaluate that target.

Before any access to client data, security approval will be required. No start date has been approved, so we can finalize timing after the necessary clearance.

Could you please approve the pilot scope and $30,000 fixed fee, subject to security clearance? Once approved, we can proceed with the security review and align on a start date.

Best,  
Jordan  
Engagement Lead
